meta.warning: Entire dataset is synthetic. Market names are illustrative labels; wallet addresses, trader counts, volumes, trades, relationships, and pipeline counts are fictional demo values. Do not present these as live or verified backend results.

pipeline.title: How Polymap finds wallet relationships
pipeline.subtitle: A transparent funnel from raw market activity to pairs worth investigating.

steps.name: Trades fetched
steps.description: Raw buy/sell activity fetched across the 12 selected markets.

steps.name: Unique wallets
steps.description: Distinct wallet addresses appearing in the fetched trades.

steps.name: Temporal edges
steps.description: Pairs of trades by different wallets in the same market within the 300-second window.

steps.name: Candidate pairs
steps.description: Wallet pairs with at least 3 qualifying temporal events.

steps.name: Tight pairs
steps.description: Pairs with median time gap ≤5 seconds and median price difference ≤$0.01.

steps.name: Persistent pairs
steps.description: Pairs observed over more than 7 days and at least 3 distinct timestamps.

definitions.temporal_edge: A connection between two trades by different wallets in the same market, no more than 300 seconds apart. It is not proof of coordination.
definitions.candidate_pair: A unique wallet pair with at least 3 qualifying temporal events.
definitions.tight: Median time gap ≤5 seconds AND median price difference ≤$0.01.
definitions.persistent: Observed over more than 7 days AND at least 3 distinct timestamps.
definitions.model_score: Experimental ranking signal; not validated and should remain secondary to observable evidence.

actual_backend_reference.note: These are previously inspected real backend run counts, included separately for comparison. They are not the synthetic demo funnel above.
